title: 소비자단체소송규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:12:0:00012:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 12 (Resignation, etc. of Litigation Representatives)
(1) Where all litigation representatives of a plaintiff have died, resigned, or been dismissed, the litigation proceedings shall be suspended until the plaintiff appoints a new litigation representative.
(2) Where litigation proceedings are suspended under paragraph (1), the court shall order the plaintiff to appoint an attorney-at-law within a specified period of at least one month.
(3) Where the plaintiff fails to appoint an attorney-at-law within the specified period notwithstanding the court's order under paragraph (2), the court shall dismiss the lawsuit by ruling.
(4) An immediate appeal may be filed against a ruling under paragraph (3).
